name: Survey fraud screening: virtual machine respondent
goal: Test whether the survey's respondent quality check detects a respondent on a virtual machine. Call fingerprint to see which signals this browser presents, then read the survey's quality-check result and compare the reasons it gives with the simulated signals. Do not try to avoid detection.
successCriteria: The survey detects the automated browser
The survey identifies the virtual-machine signals (virtual GPU, low CPU/memory, VM screen size)
